lua: local p=PREVIEW_PY; local name='##momentum_bar'; assert(p.window_present(name), 'Native chat dock was not drawn'); local x,y,w,h=p.window_x(name),p.window_y(name),p.window_width(name),p.window_height(name); assert(x==(PREVIEW.expected_x or MOCK.chat.x), 'Dock starting edge differs from expected position'); assert(w==(PREVIEW.expected_width or MOCK.chat.width), 'Dock width differs from expected span'); assert(x+w==MOCK.chat.x+MOCK.chat.width, 'Dock right edge differs from chat'); assert(y==PREVIEW.expected_y, 'Dock did not use the selected vertical position'); assert(h==(PREVIEW.expected_height or settings.bar.height), 'Dock height does not fit the safe space'); local function clear(area) return x>=area.x+area.width or x+w<=area.x or y>=area.y+area.height+2 or y+h<=area.y-2 end; assert(clear(MOCK.chat), 'Dock overlaps the primary chat border'); for _,area in ipairs(MOCK.chat.windows or {}) do assert(clear(area), 'Dock overlaps another chat window') end
